title: Limits
heading: What the figures mean
text: - Usage meters combine the account's own figures with counts recorded in the browser you are using, and show whichever is larger. Daily meters reset each day and monthly meters each calendar month, both in UTC. - Projects , Your work and the library counts come from the library saved in the browser you are using, not from the account. - Usage & cost in the API console measures the current calendar month (UTC) and needs one of your API keys to read the figures. - Projected by period end is a straight-line projection of your pace so far, not a forecast. - Where in the device list is the network address a sign-in came from, not a precise location. - Browser and system names in the device list are read from what each browser reports, and can be wrong for unusual browsers. - The token and credit balances shown are the account's records; purchased credits can take a few seconds to appear after payment.

title: Privacy
text: This page describes what the account area stores and where. The authoritative documents are the Privacy Policy (https://auricartisan.com/legal/privacy/), the Cookie Policy (https://auricartisan.com/legal/cookies/) and the Data Retention and Deletion Policy (https://auricartisan.com/legal/data-retention-and-deletion-policy/).

title: Privacy
heading: Stored with your account
text: Data Why --- --- Email address, display name, username To identify you and sign you in Bio, website, location, profile photo What you chose to put on your profile Password (as a one-way hash only) To check your password; it cannot be read back Two-step secret (encrypted) and backup codes To check your codes Sessions and sign-in records To list your devices and protect the account Dashboard preferences, including the Usage data choice So they follow you between browsers Plan, orders and payments To give you what you paid for and keep receipts Token and API credit balances and their history To meter and show your usage API keys (as a hash and a short prefix only) To recognise your keys; the full key is shown once Published portfolio To serve your public page

title: Privacy
heading: Kept in your browser, not the account
text: - My Library — palettes, gradients, collections and exports. - Portfolio draft and its counters (views, downloads, shares). - Site preferences — theme, language, accent colour, text size and other settings. - Your cookie choice. - Dismissed dashboard suggestions and the Your account is nearly there dismissal. - An API key pasted into Live usage — kept in that browser tab only, and forgotten when it closes. Clearing your browser's site data removes these. They do not follow you to another device.

title: Privacy
heading: Never reaches Auric Artisan
text: - Card numbers, UPI IDs and bank credentials. They are entered into Razorpay's checkout and go to Razorpay directly. Auric Artisan keeps only order records: what was bought, the amount and the payment reference. - Your password in readable form.

title: Privacy
heading: Cookies the account uses
text: The Cookie Policy lists two essential cookies for signed-in use: a session cookie and a cross-site request forgery (CSRF) protection cookie, each lasting up to 30 days or until you sign out. They cannot be switched off, because the account cannot work securely without them.

title: Privacy
heading: Exporting and deleting
text: - Export — Security & Privacy › Export everything downloads your account details, preferences and this browser's library and portfolio draft. See [Export your data](../docs/export-your-data.md). - Delete — the danger zone deletes the account. Personal details are removed; payment records are kept in anonymised form for tax law. See [Delete your account](../docs/delete-your-account.md). - Other requests — access, correction or a fuller copy: use the contact page, topic Privacy or data .

title: Download and offline
text: Auric Artisan is a progressive web app (PWA): a website that your browser can install like an app and keep working without an internet connection. There is nothing to download from an app store. You install it from the browser you already use, and it opens in its own window with its own icon. The Download page at https://auricartisan.com/download/ ("Install it. Then lose the connection") is where you install the app and, more importantly, prepare the offline version . Preparing it copies the site's pages, tools, libraries, palettes and data into your browser's storage while you are online, so that the workspace keeps working when you are not. You choose how much to keep with an offline profile : Auto , Lite , Balanced or Full . The page then shows exactly what is on your device: readiness checks, storage used, cached files and missing files, with buttons to audit, repair or reset the offline copy. Nothing large is downloaded unless you ask. On a first visit, the browser keeps only a small core of the site (the app shell) so that an offline visit can still show something useful.

title: Download and offline
heading: Who it is for
text: - People who work on trains, planes or unreliable connections. - Anyone who wants Auric Artisan in its own window, on the dock, taskbar or home screen. - Classrooms and studios that want tools available without depending on the network.

title: Download and offline
heading: Where to find it
text: - https://auricartisan.com/download/ - Header: the Browser PWA icon (grid with a plus). Drawer: The app (Works offline in a browser tab). - Spotlight: Install the PWA launcher, or the Install the app command.

title: Download and offline
heading: Quick start
text: 1. Open https://auricartisan.com/download/ in Chrome, Edge or Safari while you are online. 2. Select Prepare offline version . The status line shows the download's progress, and a message reads "Saving for offline — N%". 3. When it finishes (the status line reads, for example, "Balanced offline download finished: A/B assets ready.", with real numbers), check that the Readiness badge reads Offline ready . 4. If an Install app button appears, select it and confirm your browser's install dialog. On an iPhone or iPad, use Safari's Share › Add to Home Screen instead. 5. Open the installed app from its icon. It opens in its own window. 6. Turn off your connection and open a tool. It still works.

title: Download and offline
heading: What you can do
text: - Install the site as an app on Windows, macOS, Linux, ChromeOS, Android, iOS and iPadOS, where the browser offers it. - Prepare an offline copy sized for your device, from the app shell up to the whole site. - See what is cached, audit it, repair missing files, or reset it. - Keep Hindi available offline. - Get notified when an update is ready, and apply it. - Open files and shared links with the installed app, and use its shortcuts. - Remove the app and its offline data.

title: Get started with the app and offline use
Get started with the app and offline use
heading: Two separate things
text: - Installing puts Auric Artisan in its own window with an icon. Whether a browser offers this is the browser's decision. - Preparing the offline version stores the site in your browser so it works without a connection. This works in any modern browser with a secure connection, installed or not. You can do either, or both. For reliable offline use, prepare the offline version even if you install.

title: Get started with the app and offline use
heading: A tour of the Download page
text: Open https://auricartisan.com/download/. From top to bottom: 1. The head. "Auric Artisan · Browser PWA", the title Install it. Then lose the connection , one paragraph, and the actions: - Install app (only when your browser offers installation); - Update app (only when an update is waiting); - Prepare offline version ; - Download full offline ; - Open in browser (to the homepage). Below them, a status line says what is happening, with a progress bar. 2. Readiness — Is this browser ready. A badge ( Checking , Preparing , Shell ready or Offline ready ) and six checks: Shell , Full cache , Persistent storage , Local capabilities , Install and Update . Buttons: Check readiness , Audit cache , Repair cache , Reset cache . 3. Live metrics — What is actually on this device. Cache entries, storage used, CPU threads, graphics, offline profile, cache target, missing assets and the app version, then a list of Browser capabilities , and Check local hardware . 4. Profile — How much to keep. Auto , Lite , Balanced and Full , a switch to limit background work on low-power hardware, a summary, Configure profile , and a table of what each profile keeps. 5. Offline workflow — Three steps, then you can close the Wi-Fi. Prepare, Confirm, Work offline. 6. Where it runs. Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS and iPadOS, and other devices, with your current platform marked "current".

title: Get started with the app and offline use
heading: The three steps
text: 1. Prepare. While online, select Prepare offline version . The browser fills its offline store in the background; you can keep working. 2. Confirm. Check the readiness badge and the storage checks. Persistent storage matters: without it, the browser may clear the offline copy when the device runs short of space. 3. Work offline. Open cached tools and libraries from this browser, or from the installed app. Palettes and exports you make stay on the device.

title: Get started with the app and offline use

text: - [Install the app](install-the-app.md) - [Prepare the offline version](prepare-offline.md) - [What works offline](what-works-offline.md)

title: Install the app
text: The same app runs on Windows, macOS, Linux, ChromeOS, Android, iOS and iPadOS. What differs is how you install it: whether a browser offers an install button is the browser's decision. The Download page marks your current platform with "current".

title: Install the app
heading: Using the Install app button
text: In browsers that offer installation to web pages (such as Chrome and Edge on desktop and Android), the Download page shows an Install app button. 1. Open https://auricartisan.com/download/. 2. Select Install app . The status reads "Opening the browser install prompt...". 3. Confirm in your browser's dialog. Result Status line --- --- Installed "App install accepted. Finishing setup..." and a message "Auric Artisan installed" You cancelled "Install dismissed. You can still cache offline tools." Browser cannot install "Install prompt is not available in this browser." Once installed, the button reads App installed and is hidden, and the Install check reads "App is installed and running standalone." when you open the page in the app. If there is no Install app button, use your browser's own install option below.

title: Install the app
heading: Windows
text: Install from Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome : - Edge: select the app icon in the address bar, or Settings and more (…) › Apps › Install this site as an app . - Chrome: select the install icon in the address bar, or the menu (⋮) › Cast, save and share › Install page as app (wording varies by version). The app appears in the Start menu and can be pinned to the taskbar. It supports local storage, files, the clipboard and graphics acceleration.

title: Install the app
heading: macOS
text: - Safari: File › Add to Dock . - Chrome or Edge: the install icon in the address bar, or the browser menu as on Windows. The app appears in the Dock and Launchpad (Safari) or in the Applications folder (Chrome and Edge).

title: Install the app
heading: Linux
text: Install from a Chromium-family browser (Chrome, Edge, Chromium, Brave) using the install icon in the address bar or the browser menu. Firefox on desktop does not install web apps, but offline use works in any browser with service worker support, Firefox included.

title: Install the app
heading: ChromeOS
text: Use Chrome's install icon in the address bar, or the menu. The app appears in the launcher.

title: Install the app
heading: Android
text: Install from Chrome or another compatible browser: select Install app on the Download page, or open the browser menu (⋮) and choose Install app or Add to Home screen . The icon appears on your home screen and in the app drawer.

title: Install the app
heading: iOS and iPadOS
text: 1. Open https://auricartisan.com/download/ in Safari . 2. Select Share , then Add to Home Screen . 3. Confirm the name and select Add . Offline use and storage work within the limits Safari places on them on mobile devices; see [Limits and accuracy](../others/limits-and-accuracy.md).

title: Install the app
heading: Other devices
text: Any modern browser with service workers, on a secure (https) connection, can run the app and cache pages for offline use, even where it cannot be installed.

title: Install the app
heading: What installing changes
text: - Auric Artisan opens in its own window, without the browser's address bar, and appears among your apps. - The app's name is Auric Artisan (short name Auric ), with its own icon. - Right-clicking or long-pressing the icon offers shortcuts to key pages (see [Installed app features](installed-app-features.md)). - Links to the site open in the app where the system supports it. Installing does not by itself download the whole site. Prepare the offline version as well: see [Prepare the offline version](prepare-offline.md). Without the browser's toolbar, use the site's navigation dock for Back , Forward and Reload (see [Navigation dock](../../site-features/navigation-dock/README.md)).

title: Installed app features
text: These work once Auric Artisan is installed, in systems and browsers that support them (mostly Chromium-based browsers such as Chrome and Edge, and Android).

title: Installed app features
heading: App shortcuts
text: Right-click the app's icon on the taskbar or dock, or long-press it on Android, for shortcuts: Shortcut Opens --- --- Palette Library Saved and generated palettes Gradient Library Gradient collections Basic Tools The core colour tool workspace Workspace Saved local palettes, gradients, assets and exports Analyzer The website analyzer Browser PWA The Download page's offline controls

title: Installed app features
heading: Open files with the app
text: The installed app can be chosen to open these file types, for example from your file manager's Open with menu: Type Extensions --- --- JSON .json CSS .css CSV .csv Text and Markdown .txt , .md Images .png , .jpg , .jpeg , .svg The files open in your Workspace. A message reads "1 file ready" (or the number of files). Text files up to 500 KB and images up to 2 MB are read straight away; larger files are passed on to open later. If a file cannot be read, the message is "Could not open file".

title: Installed app features
heading: Share to the app
text: On systems with a share menu (such as Android), you can share a link or text to Auric Artisan . It opens in your Workspace with what you shared.

title: Installed app features
heading: Links
text: - Links to auricartisan.com can open in the installed app, and an already-open app window is reused. - The app registers two link types, web+auric: and web+palette: , which open the Workspace and the Palette Library, where the browser supports them.

title: Installed app features
heading: Standalone window
text: The app opens without the browser's toolbar. Use the site's navigation dock for Back , Forward and Reload , and Copy link to share the page you are on.

title: Prepare the offline version
heading: What is stored automatically
text: On your first visit, your browser keeps a small core of the site, called the app shell : the main pages (such as the homepage, Download, the tools index, Basic Tools, the Colour Science Lab, the Personalization Generator, the colour libraries, Search and Security), the site's styles and scripts, and the offline page. That is enough for an offline visit to show something useful, but not the whole site. Everything beyond the shell is downloaded only when you ask for it.

title: Prepare the offline version
heading: Choose a profile
text: On the Download page, under Profile — How much to keep : Profile Description on screen What it keeps Suits --- --- --- --- Auto (default) Device-aware cache choice Chooses Lite, Balanced or Full from what the device reports Almost everyone Lite Smallest offline footprint The app shell and the core tools, and little else Phones, tight storage, metered connections Balanced Core tools plus active libraries Shell, core tools and the colour libraries and their data A laptop you also use for other things Full Download the widest local cache Every file the site lists for offline use A desktop that will be offline for a while Selecting Lite , Balanced or Auto only sets the profile ("Updated offline hardware profile."). Selecting Full sets it and starts downloading at once: "Full profile selected. Downloading the full offline cache...". Condition Auto picks --- --- Limit background cache work on low-power hardware is on, the browser reports Data Saver, or the connection is 2G Lite 4 or fewer processor threads, 4 GB or less memory, or less than about 650 MB of storage available to the site Balanced Otherwise Full The Offline profile metric and the summary ( Selected , Effective profile ) show the result, for example "Auto selected Balanced for this device." The switch Limit background cache work on low-power hardware makes Auto choose Lite . Use it on older or battery-powered devices.

title: Prepare the offline version
heading: Download
text: - Prepare offline version downloads the profile in effect (your choice, or Auto's). - Download full offline downloads the Full profile regardless of your choice. While downloading: - the status line reads, for example, "Downloading the Balanced offline profile into this browser..." and then "Preparing offline version: A/B checked, C cached, D failed." (with real numbers); - a message at the edge of the screen reads "Saving for offline — N%"; - you can keep using the site, and it is best to keep the tab open until it finishes. When it finishes: - the status reads, for example, "Balanced offline download finished: A/B assets ready." (with "N failed" if some files could not be fetched); - a message reads "Full offline app ready"; - the readiness badge reads Offline ready and the cache audit runs. If files failed, select Repair cache to try them again (see [Storage and cache](storage-and-cache.md)).

title: Prepare the offline version
heading: Hindi offline
text: If the site is in Hindi when you prepare the offline version, the Hindi text is downloaded as well (about 11 MB). If you switch to Hindi later, prepare the offline version again to include it.

title: Prepare the offline version
heading: Persistent storage
text: When you prepare the offline version, the site asks the browser to keep its storage persistent , so that the browser does not clear it when the device runs low on space. Some browsers grant this automatically, some ask you, and some decide from how often you use the site. The Persistent storage check shows the result: "Persistent storage is active for this browser." or "Storage is best-effort until the browser grants persistence."

title: Prepare the offline version
heading: If the connection drops
text: If a download you started is interrupted, browsers that support background sync (such as Chrome and Edge) finish it when you are next online. Otherwise, select Prepare offline version again; files already stored are kept.

title: Prepare the offline version
heading: Data use
text: The Full profile is the whole site and can be large (more than 100 MB). On a metered or slow connection, choose Lite or Balanced , or wait for Wi-Fi. The site does not start a large download until you have asked for an offline copy at least once. After that, in browsers that support background sync, it refreshes your offline copy in the background when a new version of the site is released, so that you are not left with an old copy.

title: Storage and cache
text: The Download page reads its figures from your browser itself: the offline store, the storage estimate and the browser's capabilities. Open it on the device you care about.

title: Storage and cache
heading: Readiness checks
text: Select Check readiness to refresh them. Check Possible states --- --- Shell "Service worker shell is preparing." / "Service worker shell is ready for cached navigation." Full cache "Full offline cache is not warmed yet." / "Run prepare offline version to warm every core route." / "Offline cache has warmed this device profile." Persistent storage "Persistent storage is active for this browser." / "Storage is best-effort until the browser grants persistence." Local capabilities The number of CPU threads available for local work Install Checking / available / not offered by this browser yet / installed and running standalone / accepted / dismissed / could not be opened Update See [Updates](updates.md) The badge sums it up: Checking , Preparing , Shell ready (the core is stored) or Offline ready (your profile is complete).

title: Storage and cache
heading: Live metrics
text: Metric What it shows --- --- Cache entries How many files are stored Storage used Space used by the site, and the browser's quota for it (persistent or best effort) Local CPU Processor threads, and approximate device memory where reported Graphics WebGL 2, WebGL 1 or Canvas, and the graphics processor where reported Offline profile The profile in effect, for example "Auto selected Full for this device." Cache target How many files the profile holds Missing assets Files of the profile not yet stored (after an audit) PWA version The version of the site in your browser Browser capabilities lists each feature as Ready or Limited : Service worker, Cache API, Persistent storage, IndexedDB, File access, Clipboard, Share, Camera input, EyeDropper, Workers, Graphics and Offline privacy (a secure connection). Select Check local hardware to refresh them.

title: Storage and cache
heading: Audit the offline copy
text: Select Audit cache . The site compares your store with the profile ("Auditing Balanced cache coverage...") and reports: - "Cache audit passed. Offline profile is complete." with Missing assets at 0; or - "Cache audit found missing assets. Repair cache can retry them." with the count and the first missing file.

title: Storage and cache
heading: Repair it
text: Select Repair cache . The site fetches any missing files of the profile ("Repairing the Balanced cache profile..."), then reports "Cache repair finished: A/B assets ready." and re-runs the audit. You need to be online.

title: Storage and cache
heading: Reset it
text: Select Reset cache to delete the site's offline store and rebuild the app shell: "Resetting browser PWA caches and rebuilding the shell..." then "PWA caches reset. Shell cache rebuilt." Use it if the offline copy seems out of date or damaged. Prepare the offline version again afterwards. Reset cache does not delete your library, settings or recordings, which are kept separately in your browser.

title: Storage and cache
heading: How much space it takes
text: Storage depends on your profile. Lite is small; Balanced and Full can take from tens to more than a hundred megabytes. Storage used shows the real figure on your device.

title: Uninstall and remove data
heading: Remove the installed app
text: Uninstalling is done by your browser or system. The usual ways: - Chrome or Edge (Windows, macOS, Linux, ChromeOS): open the app, open its menu (⋮ or …) in the title bar, and choose Uninstall Auric Artisan . On Windows you can also use Settings › Apps . - Safari on macOS: remove the app from the Dock and delete it from your Applications folder. - Android: long-press the icon and choose Uninstall (or Remove ), or use App info . - iOS and iPadOS: long-press the icon, choose Remove App , then Delete from Home Screen (wording varies by version). The exact wording depends on your browser and system version.

title: Uninstall and remove data
heading: Remove the offline copy
text: Uninstalling the app may leave the offline copy and your other site data in the browser. To remove the offline copy: 1. Open https://auricartisan.com/download/. 2. Select Reset cache . The offline store is deleted and only the small app shell is rebuilt.

title: Uninstall and remove data
heading: Remove everything
text: To remove all data the site keeps in this browser (the offline copy, your settings, your library, recordings, and preferences), clear the site data for auricartisan.com in your browser's settings, usually under Privacy or Site settings . Important: Clearing site data deletes your local library items and recordings. Export or download anything you want to keep first.

title: Updates
text: Auric Artisan updates itself from the website: there is no app store update. Each release has a version name, shown on the Download page as PWA version (for example 2026-09-24-pwa-303 ).

title: Updates
heading: How you find out
text: When your browser has downloaded a newer version in the background, it waits for you. You may see: - a prompt, Update ready — "Refresh to use the newest offline cache." — with Refresh and Later ; - on the Download page, an Update app button in the head, the Update check reading "Update is ready.", and the summary's Update action saying the same; - in the right-click menu, a highlighted Update available row (see [Context menu](../../site-features/context-menu/README.md)).

title: Updates
heading: Apply an update
text: - Select Refresh on the prompt, or Update app on the Download page ("Applying update..."). The page reloads on the new version. - Or press Ctrl + Shift + U , or choose Update website in the right-click menu, which checks for an update and applies it. Later closes the prompt; the update is applied the next time all the site's tabs and app windows are closed and reopened, or when you choose to apply it.

title: Updates
heading: Check for an update
text: Open the Download page: it checks when it loads, and the Update check shows one of: State Meaning --- --- Checking for updates. A check is running Offline app is current. You have the latest version Update is ready. A newer version is waiting Applying update. The update is being applied Update check is not available. The browser cannot check (for example, no service worker) Update check failed. The check could not reach the site

title: Updates
heading: Your offline copy after an update
text: After an update, files are fetched fresh as you use them. To bring the whole offline copy up to date at once, select Prepare offline version again; the readiness checks show whether it is complete. In browsers with background sync, an offline copy you asked for before is refreshed in the background. The Update Kit also reports and applies website updates; see [Kits](../../kits/README.md).

title: What works offline
heading: Works offline, once stored
text: After you prepare the offline version, these work without a connection, as far as your profile includes them: - the pages and colour tools stored on the device; - the colour libraries and their data (Balanced and Full); - your library of saved palettes, gradients and exports, which lives on your device; - site features such as the Settings panel, theme, the right-click menu, split view between stored pages, the recorder, eye rest and the screen saver; - searching the site with Spotlight (the search index is part of the Balanced and Full profiles); - Hindi, if it was included (see [Prepare the offline version](prepare-offline.md hindi-offline)). When you go offline, a message reads Offline mode and stays until the connection returns; then Back online appears.

title: What works offline
heading: Needs a connection
text: Anything that has to reach a server: - signing in, your account, billing and anything synced to your account; - the Analyzer's audits of live websites; - the Web tab in Spotlight and web results on the search page; - sending feedback (it is kept and sent when you are back online); - installing or updating the app; - pages and files you have not stored.

title: What works offline
heading: How pages are served
text: - Pages are fetched fresh from the network when you are online, and stored as you visit them. Offline, the stored copy is used. - Styles, scripts, images and library data are served from storage when available and refreshed in the background. So a page you have visited recently is usually available offline even without preparing the offline version, but only preparing it guarantees a complete set.

title: What works offline
heading: The offline page

title: Troubleshooting the app and offline use
Troubleshooting the app and offline use
heading: There is no Install app button
text: Why: the button appears only in browsers that let pages offer installation, such as Chrome and Edge. Safari and Firefox do not; the site is already installed; or the browser has decided not to offer it yet. What to do: use your browser's own install option (see [Install the app](install-the-app.md)). On iPhone and iPad, use Safari's Share › Add to Home Screen . You can still prepare the offline version without installing.

title: Troubleshooting the app and offline use
heading: "Install prompt is not available in this browser."
text: Why: the browser did not offer installation to the page, or you dismissed it recently. What to do: use the browser menu to install, or try later.

title: Troubleshooting the app and offline use
heading: "PWA runtime is still loading."
text: Why: the offline system starts after the page finishes loading. What to do: wait a few seconds; if it does not clear, reload the page.

title: Troubleshooting the app and offline use
heading: "Offline download could not start yet."
text: Why: the browser has not finished setting up the site's offline system, or service workers are blocked (for example in some private windows or by an extension). What to do: reload the page and try again. Use a normal window, and make sure the site is not blocked from storing data.

title: Troubleshooting the app and offline use
heading: The download finished with failed files
text: Why: some files could not be fetched, usually because of a brief network problem. What to do: select Repair cache while online.

title: Troubleshooting the app and offline use
heading: Persistent storage stays "best-effort"
text: Why: the browser decides whether to grant it. Some grant it only to installed apps or sites you use often. What to do: install the app, keep using the site, and check again. Until then, keep some free space on the device so the browser has no reason to clear the offline copy.

title: Troubleshooting the app and offline use
heading: A page says "You are offline"
text: Why: that page was not stored before the connection dropped. What to do: open one of the pages listed under Saved on this device , or select Try again when you are back online. Next time, prepare a larger profile.

title: Troubleshooting the app and offline use
heading: The site seems out of date
text: Why: an update is waiting, or your offline copy predates a release. What to do: select Refresh on the Update ready prompt, Update app on the Download page, or press Ctrl + Shift + U . Then prepare the offline version again.

title: Troubleshooting the app and offline use
heading: Storage is nearly full
text: What to do: choose Lite or Balanced , select Reset cache and prepare again, or free space on the device.

title: Troubleshooting the app and offline use
heading: iPhone or iPad cleared the offline copy
text: Why: mobile Safari limits storage for websites and may clear it for sites that have not been used for a while. What to do: add the site to your Home Screen, open it regularly, and prepare the offline version again when needed.

title: Download and offline FAQ
heading: Is there a desktop app to download?
text: The app is installed from your browser, not downloaded as a separate program. It then runs in its own window. The browser extension and the VS Code extensions are separate products.

title: Download and offline FAQ
heading: Is the app free?
text: Yes. Installing and using it offline costs nothing. Every tool is free on every plan.

title: Download and offline FAQ
heading: Does the installed app need an account?
text: No. An account is needed only for account features, which also need a connection.

title: Download and offline FAQ
heading: Do my saved palettes work offline?
text: Yes. Your library is kept on your device and works offline.

title: Download and offline FAQ
heading: Does the app update itself?
text: Yes, from the website. When a new version is ready you are asked to refresh; see [Updates](updates.md).

title: Download and offline FAQ
heading: Can I install it on more than one device?
text: Yes. Install and prepare it on each device. Your library and settings stay on each device separately, unless you use account features that sync them.

title: Download and offline FAQ
heading: How much space does it need?
text: It depends on the profile. Lite is small; Full can take more than 100 MB. The Storage used figure on the Download page shows your actual use.

title: Download and offline FAQ
heading: Which browsers work best?
text: For installing: Chrome and Edge on desktop and Android, and Safari on iPhone and iPad (Add to Home Screen) and on macOS (Add to Dock). For offline use: any current browser with service workers on a secure connection.

title: Download and offline glossary
text: Term Meaning --- --- PWA Progressive web app: a website a browser can install like an app and run offline. Install Adding the site to your device as an app with its own window and icon. Standalone Running in its own window without the browser's toolbar. Service worker A part of the site that runs in your browser and serves stored files when you are offline. Cache The browser's store of site files kept for offline use. App shell The small core of pages, styles and scripts stored automatically on your first visit. Offline profile How much of the site to store: Auto, Lite, Balanced or Full. Persistent storage Browser storage that is not cleared automatically when space runs low. Best-effort storage Browser storage that the browser may clear when space runs low. Quota The amount of storage the browser allows the site to use. Audit A check of which files of your profile are stored and which are missing. Background sync A browser feature that finishes a task, such as a download, when you are next online. Share target An app that appears in your device's share menu.

title: Download and offline limits and accuracy
Download and offline limits and accuracy
heading: Platform limits
text: - Installing depends on the browser. Chrome and Edge offer it on desktop and Android; Safari offers Add to Home Screen on iPhone and iPad and Add to Dock on macOS; Firefox on desktop does not install web apps. - Offline use needs a browser with service workers and a secure (https) connection. It does not work in browsers or modes that block service workers or site storage. - Mobile Safari limits how much a website may store and may clear it if the site is not used for a while. - App shortcuts, file opening, sharing to the app and link types work only where the system and browser support them, mostly Chromium-based browsers and Android. - Background sync , which finishes interrupted downloads, is available only in some browsers.

title: Download and offline limits and accuracy
heading: Storage
text: - The browser sets the site's quota. The Storage used figure shows use and quota as the browser reports them. - Without persistent storage, the browser may clear the offline copy when the device is short of space. - Reset cache clears only the offline copy. Your library, settings and recordings are separate.

title: Download and offline limits and accuracy
heading: What the figures mean
text: - Cache entries counts stored files; it includes pages you visited as well as prepared files. - Cache target is the number of files in the profile for the current release; it changes between releases. - Local CPU , device memory and Graphics are what the browser chooses to report. Some browsers report less, or round the figures, for privacy. - Offline ready means every file of your profile is stored, as of the last check. It does not mean that features needing a server work offline. - Auto's choice is based on the reported figures and connection type at the moment you prepare.

title: Download and offline limits and accuracy
heading: What offline cannot do
text: Signing in, account data, live website audits, web search, installing and updating need a connection. See [What works offline](../docs/what-works-offline.md).

title: Download and offline privacy
heading: Stored on your device
text: - The offline copy of the site's files, in your browser's storage for auricartisan.com. - Your profile choice, the low-power switch, and whether you have asked for an offline copy (so an interrupted or out-of-date copy can be completed later). - Files you open with the installed app, or text and links you share to it, are held on your device for the Workspace to pick up.

title: Download and offline privacy
heading: What the Download page reads
text: The page reads your device's processor thread count, approximate memory, graphics processor name, connection type and storage estimate, as your browser reports them. It uses them to show the metrics and to choose the Auto profile. It does not send them to Auric Artisan.

title: Download and offline privacy
heading: What uses the network
text: - Downloading the offline copy and updates, from auricartisan.com. - Checking for updates.

title: Download and offline privacy
heading: Removing it
text: Select Reset cache on the Download page, uninstall the app, or clear the site's data in your browser (see [Uninstall and remove data](../docs/uninstall.md)).

title: Advertise on Auric Artisan
text: AdsSense is Auric Artisan's own advertising system. It puts your product in front of the designers, developers and colour scientists who use the site, next to the tools and articles they came for. The page at https://auricartisan.com/advertise/ has everything in one place: the formats and their prices, a live example of each placement, and a six-step campaign builder that shows the full price before you send anything. Every ad is clearly labelled Sponsored . Ads are placed by page context, not by following people across sites: you choose where your campaign runs, and the audience groups you pick guide the creative review only. Every creative that runs is listed publicly in the Ad Library at https://auricartisan.com/advertise/library/. Campaigns are booked by request. When you send a campaign from the builder, nothing is booked and nothing is charged. Auric Artisan confirms the campaign and then sends you a Razorpay link to pay the price you were shown. Your campaign runs after payment and creative approval.

title: Advertise on Auric Artisan
heading: Who it is for
text: - Companies and makers of design, development and colour products. - Studios, educators and communities that want to reach people who work with colour. - Anyone launching a product to a design-minded audience.

title: Advertise on Auric Artisan
heading: Where to find it
text: - The campaign page: https://auricartisan.com/advertise/ - The Ad Library: https://auricartisan.com/advertise/library/ - Questions about custom flights, bulk buys or studio-made creatives: Contact us at https://auricartisan.com/company/contact/ - No account is needed to build and send a campaign request.

title: Advertise on Auric Artisan
heading: Quick start
text: 1. Open https://auricartisan.com/advertise/ and go to Create your campaign . 2. Basics : name the campaign, add your brand and the address clicks should go to, and choose a goal. 3. Format : choose one of the four formats. The goal you chose marks one as Recommended . 4. Creative : design the ad in the built-in studio, or upload finished artwork. 5. Audience : choose where it runs and how often one visitor can see it. 6. Budget : choose the flight length, start date, share of voice and currency, and add a promo code if you have one. 7. Review : check the summary, add a billing email, accept the policies and select Request campaign . 8. Wait for Auric Artisan to confirm and send a Razorpay payment link.

title: Advertise on Auric Artisan
heading: What you can do
text: - Choose from four formats — Leaderboard, Medium Rectangle, Native In-Feed Card, and Panels & Search Strip — and five zones, from the homepage to the whole site. - See a live quote and a delivery estimate that update with every choice. - Build the final click address with UTM auto-tagging, custom parameters and tracking macros. - Design an accessible creative with a live contrast check, or upload PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG artwork. - Pay in Indian rupees or US dollars, with lower daily rates for longer flights. - Receive a flight report at the end of the campaign. - Browse every ad that runs on Auric Artisan in the Ad Library, and report one that breaks the rules.

title: Getting started with advertising
heading: Before you start
text: Have these ready: - The address you want clicks to go to. - Your brand or company name. - An email address for receipts and campaign updates. - Finished artwork, if you have it. If not, you can design the ad on the page. You do not need an Auric Artisan account.

title: Getting started with advertising
heading: A tour of the page
text: https://auricartisan.com/advertise/ is one long page. A row of links near the top jumps to each part: Campaign builder , Live placements , Formats , Ad Library and Policy & measurement . - The introduction — Put your work in front of people who build with color. , with Create a campaign and View live ads . Figures beside it describe the audience, such as the estimated daily ad views and the number of Learn guides. - Engine telemetry — this page, right now — four live counts for the ads on the page you are reading: units mounted , impressions , MRC-viewable and clicks . They are measured in your browser, not modelled. - See a live placement — real ad units, served the same way your campaign would be. A unit with no ad to show disappears. - Formats & benchmarks — a table of the four formats with size, position, typical click-through rate, what each is best for and the starting price. - Create your campaign — the six-step builder, with the live quote beside it. - The Ad Library — a preview and a link to every ad that runs on the site. - Creative specs — the size and file guidance for each format, and the rules creatives must follow. - Serving policy & measurement — how ads are served and measured. - Questions before you book? — Contact us for custom flights, bulk buys or studio-made creatives.

title: Getting started with advertising
heading: Send your first request
text: 1. Select Create a campaign . 2. In Basics , enter a Campaign name , your Brand / company and the Destination URL . Choose a goal under What should this campaign do? , for example Site traffic . Select Continue . 3. In Format , keep the Recommended format or choose another. Select Continue . 4. In Creative , type a headline and supporting line in the studio, or choose Choose a file to upload artwork. Watch the Live preview . Select Continue . 5. In Audience , choose where the ad runs and the Frequency cap . Select Continue . 6. In Budget , choose a Flight length , Start date and Share of voice . The quote on the side updates as you go. Select Review campaign . 7. In Review , check the Campaign summary , enter your Billing email and tick the policy box. 8. Select Request campaign in the quote panel. The button shows the total and (pay on approval) . The page confirms: Request received. We confirm availability and send a Razorpay payment link within 1 business day — your campaign goes live after payment. Your draft saves itself in this browser as you work, so you can leave and come back. It is cleared once the request is sent.

title: The Ad Library
text: The Ad Library at https://auricartisan.com/advertise/library/ lists every ad that runs on Auric Artisan: Every ad, in the open . Each entry shows the creative, the advertiser, the format, where it runs, its flight dates and its landing address. There are no hidden ads and no ads shown only to some people. An ad is listed for its full run and for at least 90 days after it ends. Anyone can open the library; no account is needed.

title: The Ad Library
heading: Browse the library
text: At the top of the page: - Search advertiser or text… — filters the ads by advertiser, ad text or landing address as you type. - Format chips — All formats , Leaderboard , Rectangle , In-feed and Strip . - Status chips — All , Active and Ended . The count beside the filters says how many ads match, for example 12 ads . If none match, the page says No ads match those filters.

title: The Ad Library
heading: Read an ad
text: Each card shows: Item Meaning --- --- Creative The ad exactly as it is served. Advertiser Who runs the ad. Auric Artisan's own promotions are marked (house) . Status badge Active or Ended . Format For example Leaderboard · 728×90 . Runs on The zones where it appears, such as Homepage or Learn library (113 articles) . Flight since and the start date, or the start and end dates. Landing Where a click goes. Addresses on Auric Artisan open in the same tab; other sites open in a new tab. Report this ad Opens the contact page.

title: The Ad Library
heading: Report an ad
text: If an ad breaks the creative policy — for example it imitates a button or system dialog, is not labelled Sponsored , or misleads — select Report this ad on its card, or Report it in About this library . Both open https://auricartisan.com/company/contact/. Auric Artisan pulls violating creatives within one business day.

title: The Ad Library
heading: Who may sell these ads
text: The file https://auricartisan.com/ads.txt declares every authorised seller of Auric Artisan's ad space.

title: The Ad Library
heading: Advertise yourself
text: Want your brand here? at the foot of the page links to the campaign builder with Start a campaign → , and to the contact page with Talk to us . See [Create a campaign](create-a-campaign.md).

title: Create a campaign
text: The campaign builder is under Create your campaign on https://auricartisan.com/advertise/. It has six steps: Basics , Format , Creative , Audience , Budget and Review . The quote panel beside it shows the step you are on, for example Step 2/6 , and updates the price with every choice.

title: Create a campaign
heading: Moving between steps
text: - Continue → checks the current step and moves on. If something is missing, a message under the buttons says what, for example Add a campaign name to continue. - On the fifth step the button reads Review campaign → . - ← Back returns to the previous step. - The numbered step chips at the top open any step you have already reached. Your draft is saved in this browser automatically, with the note Draft saved locally . If you come back later, the builder picks up where you left off. A start date that has passed is moved to tomorrow.

title: Create a campaign
heading: Step 1: Basics
text: Start with the campaign basics. Field What to enter Limit --- --- --- Campaign name A name for your own reference. Only you see it. 2 to 80 characters Brand / company Who is running the campaign. 2 to 80 characters Destination URL Where every click lands. A bare domain is completed with https:// when you leave the field. Up to 500 characters in the field Below these, Destination & tracking builds the final click address, with auto-tagging, custom parameters and tracking macros. See [Destination and tracking](destination-and-tracking.md). Then choose a goal under What should this campaign do? : Brand awareness , Site traffic or Product launch . Each recommends a format, zone and share of voice, and choosing one applies them. See [Formats and placements](formats-and-placements.md).

title: Create a campaign
heading: Step 2: Format
text: Choose how your campaign appears. Four cards show each format with its size, a short description and its from price per day. The format your goal recommends has a Recommended badge. Select a card to choose it.

title: Create a campaign
heading: Step 3: Creative
text: Make the creative yours. Choose a Creative source : - Design it here — the built-in creative studio. - Choose a file — upload finished artwork. The Live preview shows the result at the exact ratio of your format, with the Sponsored label. See [Design your creative](design-your-creative.md). To continue, you need either a studio design or an uploaded file. Otherwise the message is Choose an artwork file or switch to the creative studio.

title: Create a campaign
heading: Step 4: Audience
text: Choose the right context. Auric Artisan places campaigns by page context, not by cross-site profiles. - Where it runs — choose one zone. Each shows its estimated daily views. - Creative context (guidance only — never personal tracking) — choose up to three groups: Designers , Developers , Color scientists , Educators , Studios & teams . These guide the creative review. They do not identify or follow individual visitors. Choosing none is shown as Everyone in the review. - Frequency cap — how many times one visitor can see your ad in a browsing session: 1 / session (gentle), 2 / session (balanced) or 3 / session (assertive).

title: Create a campaign
heading: Step 5: Budget
text: Set the flight and budget. - Flight length — 1 week (standard rate), 2 weeks (save 5%), 1 month (save 15%) or 3 months (save 28%). - Start date — the earliest is tomorrow. Campaigns start at 00:00 IST on the day you choose, after creative approval. - Share of voice — the fraction of eligible ad renders reserved for your campaign: 25% share , 50% share or 100% takeover . - Currency — INR ₹ or USD $ . - Promo code — type a code if you have one. A valid code shows a tick and its offer; an invalid one shows unknown code . See [Pricing and booking](pricing-and-booking.md) for how these change the price.

title: Create a campaign
heading: Step 6: Review
text: Review and send. - Campaign summary — a thumbnail of the creative and every choice: campaign, brand, objective, format, creative, where it runs, audiences, frequency cap, flight, share of voice, the final destination address, tracking, promo and total. - Billing contact — your Billing email . Receipts and campaign updates are sent here. - Three assurances: Clearly labelled Sponsored , No cross-site tracking and Creative reviewed before launch . - A checkbox to accept the creative and acceptable-use policy and the refund policy, confirming that your ad will be clearly labelled "Sponsored". The policy names link to https://auricartisan.com/legal/acceptable-use-policy/ and https://auricartisan.com/legal/refund/.

title: Create a campaign
heading: Send the request
text: The button at the foot of the quote panel reads Complete campaign to request booking until every step is complete. Then it reads Request campaign with the total, for example Request campaign — ₹3,493 (pay on approval) . Select it to send. - While sending: Sending booking request… - When it arrives: Request received. We confirm availability and send a Razorpay payment link within 1 business day — your campaign goes live after payment. A Campaign submitted panel shows a reference beginning REQ- and a summary of the campaign. Keep the reference. - If it cannot be sent: Could not send the request — please email ads@auricartisan.com with your campaign details. Sending books nothing and charges nothing. See [Pricing and booking](pricing-and-booking.md) for what happens next.

title: Design your creative
text: The third step of the campaign builder, Creative , is where you make the ad itself. Under Creative source , choose Design it here to use the built-in creative studio, or Choose a file to upload finished artwork. The Live preview always shows your creative at the exact ratio of the format you chose, for example 728×90 · Leaderboard , with the Sponsored label.

title: Design your creative
heading: Design it in the studio
text: The studio renders your text and colours as a crisp vector image at the exact size of your format. Field What it is Limit If left empty --- --- --- --- Headline The main line. 40 characters Your brand name Supporting line One clear reason to click. 60 characters "Reach people who work in color" Call to action The button text. 20 characters "LEARN MORE" Creative description A description of the visual for screen readers. 120 characters A description made from your brand name Background The background colour. Colour picker FFF8EC Accent The colour of the border, the side bar or mark, and the button. Colour picker D3AF37 Text The colour of the headline and supporting line. Colour picker 1F2937 The button text is set in dark or white automatically, to stand out on the accent colour. Under the colours, a line checks the headline against the background, for example Headline contrast 13.90:1 — passes WCAG AA ✓ with the default colours. Below 4.5:1 it reads below WCAG AA, consider darker text . The check is advice; it does not stop you continuing. - Leaderboard : an accent bar on the left, the headline and supporting line beside it, and the call-to-action button on the right. - Panels & Search Strip : an accent bar, the headline and supporting line, and an accent dot on the right. - Medium Rectangle and Native In-Feed Card : a centred accent mark, headline, supporting line and button. Every studio design has a thin accent border and a small AD mark in the top-right corner. If you change format, the design is redrawn at the new size.

Remove clears it. A ratio within about 3% of the format counts as a match.

title: Design your creative
heading: The creative policy
text: Every creative is reviewed before launch. The advertise page states the rules: - Creatives are clearly labelled Sponsored . - They never imitate the site's interface. Creatives that pretend to be buttons or system dialogs are rejected. - They never auto-play sound. - They never track visitors across sites. When you send the request, you also accept the creative and acceptable-use policy at https://auricartisan.com/legal/acceptable-use-policy/.

title: Design your creative
heading: Accessibility tips
text: - Aim for a headline contrast of at least 4.5:1; the studio's check tells you where you stand. - Always fill in Creative description , so screen-reader users know what the ad shows. - Keep the call to action short and specific.

title: Destination and tracking
text: The Destination URL in the first step is where every click on your ad lands. Below it, Destination & tracking builds the full address that clicks will actually use, called the Final URL .

title: Destination and tracking
heading: The destination address
text: - Type the address of your landing page. If you type a bare domain such as your-product.com , it becomes https://your-product.com when you leave the field. - Display link shows the short form of the address that goes with the ad: the site and the start of the path. - Test link ↗ opens the final address with sample values in place of the macros, so you can check it loads. It appears once the address is valid. Message Meaning --- --- Enter a destination URL. The field is empty. That doesn't parse as a complete URL — include https://. The address is incomplete. Only http(s) destinations can be served. The address uses another scheme. Credentials inside the URL are not allowed. The address contains a user name or password. That hostname doesn't look reachable. The site name is not a full domain. These stop you continuing. Two warnings let you continue: - Not secure (http) — browsers may warn your visitors. Prefer https. - Link shorteners hide the real destination from the Ad Library — use the final URL. This appears for common shorteners such as bit.ly and tinyurl.com. When all is well, the status reads Looks good — clicks go straight to this URL. , or Looks good — followed by how many tracking parameters will ride along on every click.

title: Destination and tracking
heading: Auto-tagging
text: Auto-tagging adds UTM parameters to the final address, so visits from the campaign show up attributed in your analytics. It is on by default. Untick it to send clicks to the address exactly as you typed it, plus any custom parameters. Parameter Default --- --- utm source auricartisan utm medium adssense utm campaign Made from your campaign name, for example summer-product-launch utm content {placement} utm term {zone} Edit any value, up to 60 characters. An empty value is left out. Leave utm campaign empty to keep it following the campaign name.

title: Destination and tracking
heading: Custom URL parameters
text: Select + Add parameter to add your own name and value, up to five parameters. - A name can use letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores, up to 32 characters. Otherwise the builder says Custom parameter names can only use letters, numbers, dot, dash and underscore. - A value can be up to 200 characters and can include macros. - A parameter with the same name as a UTM parameter replaces it. - Parameters already in your destination address are kept. - Select ✕ to remove a parameter.

title: Destination and tracking
heading: Tracking macros
text: Macros are placeholders that are filled in each time the ad is shown. Select a macro chip to insert it where your cursor was in the tracking fields. Macro Replaced with --- --- {placement} The unit that served the click: leader , rect , strip or infeed . {zone} The zone this campaign runs on. {campaign} Your campaign's order ID. {clickid} A unique ID for each ad shown, for attribution.

title: Destination and tracking
heading: The final URL
text: Final URL shows the complete address, with the macros still in braces. This is the address that appears as Destination in the review step and in your booking request. For example, with the defaults, a destination of https://your-product.com/ and the campaign name "Summer product launch", the final URL is: https://your-product.com/?utm source=auricartisan&utm medium=adssense&utm campaign=summer-product-launch&utm content={placement}&utm term={zone}

title: Formats and placements
heading: How ads are shown
text: - Every format is clearly labelled Sponsored . - Ad units render only as they come near the part of the page on screen. - Viewability is measured to the MRC standard: at least 50% of the ad visible for one second. - A frequency cap limits how often one visitor sees your ad in a browsing session. - A slot with no ad to fill it disappears from the page. - Paid Auric Artisan subscribers browse without ads, so they do not see your campaign. - No third-party ad technology runs unless a visitor accepts the marketing cookie category. The See a live placement section of https://auricartisan.com/advertise/ shows real units served this way.

title: Pricing and booking
heading: The live quote
text: Beside the campaign builder, the Live estimate panel prices your campaign as you build it. Every choice updates it at once, and the price shown is the price you are asked to pay. Your campaign shows: Line Meaning --- --- Summary Format, zone, days and share, for example Leaderboard · Run of site (everywhere) · 30 days @ 50% . Base run The price before discounts. Flight discount The saving for a longer flight. Shown only when there is one. Promo The promo code saving, with the code. Shown only when there is one. Tax Shown only when tax applies. Total What you pay. Estimated delivery shows: Figure Meaning --- --- impressions How many times the ad is expected to be shown: the zone's daily views, times the days, times your share of voice. est. uniques Roughly how many different people see it. est. clicks Impressions times the format's typical click-through rate. eff. CPM The effective price per thousand impressions, before tax. These are estimates. Your flight report shows what was actually delivered.

title: Pricing and booking
heading: What changes the price
text: - Format : each has a daily rate, from ₹299 ($4) to ₹649 ($8) a day. See [Formats and placements](formats-and-placements.md). - Zone : busier zones cost more a day. Run of site (everywhere) costs the most and reaches the most views. - Flight length : longer flights have a lower daily rate. 1 week is the standard rate; 2 weeks save 5%, 1 month saves 15% and 3 months save 28%. - Share of voice : 25% share , 50% share or 100% takeover of the eligible ad renders in your zone. A larger share costs more and delivers more impressions. - Promo code : a valid code takes a percentage off the total after the flight discount. - Currency : INR ₹ or USD $ . Each currency has its own rates.

title: Pricing and booking
heading: Send the request
text: The button at the foot of the quote panel reads Request campaign with the total and (pay on approval) once every step is complete. The note under it reads Nothing is charged here · we confirm the campaign, then send a Razorpay link for the price shown . Sending the request books nothing and charges nothing.

title: Pricing and booking
heading: What happens next
text: 1. Confirmation. Auric Artisan confirms availability and sends a Razorpay payment link to your billing email within one business day. 2. Payment. You pay the price shown in your quote through the Razorpay link. 3. Creative review. Before launch, your creative and destination are reviewed for policy compliance. 4. Launch. The campaign starts at 00:00 IST on your start date, after creative approval, and runs for the flight you chose. 5. Transparency. While it runs, the campaign is listed in the [Ad Library](ad-library.md). 6. Flight report. At the end, you receive a report of impressions, MRC-viewable impressions, clicks and effective CPM, measured by the ad system rather than estimated. The request carries your campaign details as text: the campaign and brand names, format, zone, dates, share of voice, goal, frequency cap, audiences, final destination address, quoted total and estimated impressions. Your artwork is not attached to the request, so keep your file, or your studio settings, ready for when Auric Artisan replies.

title: Pricing and booking
heading: Refunds
text: From the refund policy at https://auricartisan.com/legal/refund/: - An advertising booking is refundable in full at any time before the campaign start date. - Once a campaign has started, refunds for the remaining, undelivered part are handled case by case, based on the booking terms shown at purchase.

title: Troubleshooting
heading: Continue does nothing
text: Why: Something in the current step is missing or not valid. The message under the buttons says what. What to do: Read the message and fix that field. In the first step, fields with a problem are also marked. See the messages in the [Reference](reference.md).

title: Troubleshooting
heading: I cannot open a later step from the step chips
text: Why: The chips open only steps you have already reached with Continue . What to do: Work through the steps in order once. After that you can jump between them.

title: Troubleshooting
heading: The destination address is rejected
text: Why: It is incomplete, uses a scheme other than http or https, contains a user name or password, or its site name is not a full domain. What to do: Paste the full address from your browser's address bar, starting https:// . Use the final address, not a link shortener.

title: Troubleshooting
heading: My uploaded file is rejected
text: Why: The file is not PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG, is over 300 KB, or cannot be read as an image. What to do: Export the artwork again in one of the four types and compress it under 300 KB. The Creative specs section suggests under 150 KB for the Leaderboard and Medium Rectangle.

title: Troubleshooting
heading: The preview crops my artwork
text: Why: The artwork's shape does not match the format. What to do: Upload artwork at the recommended size for your format, shown under the upload area: 728×90, 300×250, 320×100, or 720×600 for the in-feed card.

title: Troubleshooting
heading: The studio says "below WCAG AA"
text: Why: The headline colour and background have less than 4.5:1 contrast. What to do: Choose a darker Text colour or a lighter Background , or the other way round. You can continue anyway, but a readable ad performs better and is fairer to readers.

title: Troubleshooting
heading: The start date will not go earlier
text: Why: The earliest start date is tomorrow. What to do: Choose tomorrow or later. The campaign starts at 00:00 IST on that day, after creative approval.

title: Troubleshooting
heading: My promo code shows "unknown code"
text: Why: The code is not recognised. What to do: Check the spelling; codes are not case-sensitive. The quote shows a Promo line only when a code is valid.

title: Troubleshooting
heading: The request button stays on "Complete campaign to request booking"
text: Why: One of the steps is incomplete: usually the billing email or the policy checkbox in Review . What to do: Go to the Review step. Enter a valid Billing email , tick the policy box, and check the earlier steps: each needs a campaign name, brand, valid destination, creative and start date.

title: Troubleshooting
heading: "Could not send the request"
text: Why: The request did not reach Auric Artisan. What to do: Try again. If it still fails, email ads@auricartisan.com with your campaign details, as the message says. Your draft stays in this browser until a request is sent.

title: Troubleshooting
heading: The confirmation says "Payment verified", but I have not paid
text: Why: The Campaign submitted panel uses the same wording for every campaign. For a booking request, nothing has been charged. The reference beginning REQ- identifies your request, and the Payment line stays empty. What to do: Keep the reference and wait for the Razorpay payment link at your billing email, within one business day.

title: Troubleshooting
heading: I have not received the payment link
text: Why: Confirmation can take up to one business day, or the email may have been filtered. What to do: Check your spam folder for the billing email you entered. After one business day, use Contact us at https://auricartisan.com/company/contact/ and quote your REQ- reference.

title: Troubleshooting
heading: My draft has gone
text: Why: Drafts are saved in the browser you used. Another browser or device, a private window, or clearing site data starts a new draft. A draft is also cleared once its request is sent. What to do: Build the campaign again. Keep your artwork file to hand.

title: Troubleshooting
heading: My campaign is not in the Ad Library
text: Why: Campaigns appear in the Ad Library while they run, after confirmation, payment and creative approval. What to do: Check again after your start date.

title: Advertise FAQ
heading: Do I pay when I send the campaign?
text: No. Sending books nothing and charges nothing. Auric Artisan confirms the campaign and sends a Razorpay link for the price you were shown.

title: Advertise FAQ
heading: How soon can my campaign start?
text: The earliest start date is tomorrow. A campaign starts at 00:00 IST on its start date, after payment and creative approval. The confirmation and payment link arrive within one business day of your request.

title: Advertise FAQ
heading: Do I need an account?
text: No. You need a billing email for receipts and campaign updates.

title: Advertise FAQ
heading: Which currencies can I pay in?
text: Indian rupees or US dollars. Choose in the Budget step.

title: Advertise FAQ
heading: Is tax included?
text: The quote shows a Tax line when tax applies. The Total is the price you are asked to pay.

title: Advertise FAQ
heading: Can I target individual people?
text: No. Campaigns are placed by page context: you choose the zone. The audience groups you choose guide the creative review only; they do not identify or follow visitors.

title: Advertise FAQ
heading: Do my ads track visitors?
text: No. Ads never track visitors across sites. Third-party ad technology runs only for visitors who accept the marketing cookie category.

title: Advertise FAQ
heading: How is my campaign measured?
text: Impressions, MRC-viewable impressions (at least half the ad visible for one second), clicks and effective CPM. You receive them in a flight report at the end of the campaign.

title: Advertise FAQ
heading: Who sees my ad?
text: Visitors to the zone you chose, up to your frequency cap per session. Paid Auric Artisan subscribers browse without ads.

title: Advertise FAQ
heading: What is share of voice?
text: The fraction of eligible ad renders in your zone that are reserved for your campaign: 25%, 50% or 100%.

title: Advertise FAQ
heading: Can I change the format after designing the creative?
text: Yes. A studio design is redrawn at the new size. An uploaded file may be cropped to the new shape; upload artwork at the new size for the sharpest result.

title: Advertise FAQ
heading: Can Auric Artisan make the creative for me?
text: Ask through Contact us at https://auricartisan.com/company/contact/, which the advertise page offers for studio-made creatives, custom flights and bulk buys.

title: Advertise FAQ
heading: Can I get a refund?
text: Yes, in full, at any time before the campaign start date. After it starts, refunds for the undelivered part are handled case by case. See https://auricartisan.com/legal/refund/.

title: Advertise FAQ
heading: Is my ad listed publicly?
text: Yes. Every ad that runs is listed in the [Ad Library](ad-library.md) for its full run and at least 90 days after.

title: Advertise FAQ
heading: What gets an ad rejected?
text: Ads that imitate the site's interface, such as fake buttons or system dialogs, that auto-play sound, or that track visitors across sites. Every ad must be labelled Sponsored . See [Design your creative](design-your-creative.md).

title: Advertise glossary
text: Term Meaning --- --- Ad Library The public list of every ad that runs on Auric Artisan. ads.txt A public file that declares who may sell a site's ad space. AdsSense Auric Artisan's own advertising system. Auto-tagging Adding UTM parameters to the click address automatically. Booking request A campaign sent from the builder. It books and charges nothing until confirmed and paid. Call to action The button text on an ad, such as "LEARN MORE". Campaign One ad in one format and zone, for one flight. Creative The ad itself: the artwork people see. CTR (click-through rate) Clicks divided by impressions. Destination URL The page a click on the ad opens. Display link The short form of the destination shown with the ad. eff. CPM Effective cost per thousand impressions: the price divided by estimated impressions, times 1,000. Final URL The destination with tracking parameters added. Flight The period a campaign runs, from its start date. Flight report The report of delivered impressions, viewable impressions, clicks and effective CPM at the end of a campaign. Format The shape of an ad: Leaderboard, Medium Rectangle, Native In-Feed Card, or Panels & Search Strip. Frequency cap The most times one visitor can see your ad in a browsing session. House ad An ad for Auric Artisan's own products, marked "(house)" in the Ad Library. Impression One showing of an ad. Macro A placeholder in the click address, such as {zone} , filled in each time the ad is shown. MRC-viewable Counted as seen: at least 50% of the ad visible for one second. Share of voice The fraction of eligible ad renders in a zone reserved for your campaign. Sponsored The label every ad on Auric Artisan carries. Takeover A 100% share of voice. UTM parameters Standard tags such as utm source that analytics tools use to attribute visits. Zone The part of the site a campaign runs on, such as the Homepage or Run of site.

title: Limits and accuracy
heading: The price
text: The quote in the builder is the price you are asked to pay. It is worked out from the format's daily rate, the zone, the flight length, the share of voice and any promo code, in the currency you chose. The payment link is for the price shown.

title: Limits and accuracy
heading: The delivery estimate
text: - Impressions are estimated from each zone's typical daily views, shown on the zone buttons, multiplied by the days in the flight and your share of voice. Real traffic varies from day to day. - Unique viewers are a rough estimate from impressions. - Clicks use each format's typical click-through rate: house averages measured by the ad system, not a promise for your ad. - eff. CPM divides the price before tax by the estimated impressions. - The figures on the page, such as estimated daily ad views, are the page's own estimates. Your flight report gives the delivered figures, measured by the ad system rather than estimated.

title: Limits and accuracy
heading: What reduces delivery
text: - Paid Auric Artisan subscribers browse without ads. - Your frequency cap limits how often one visitor sees the ad. - Ad units render only as they come near the part of the page on screen, so a unit far down a page a visitor never scrolls to is not shown.

title: Limits and accuracy
heading: Builder limits

title: Privacy
heading: For advertisers
text: When you select Request campaign , Auric Artisan receives: - Your brand or company name and your billing email. - The campaign details: campaign name, goal, format, zone, flight, start date, share of voice, frequency cap, audience groups, final destination address, quoted total and estimated impressions. Your billing email is used for receipts and campaign updates. Your draft, including any uploaded artwork, is saved in this browser while you build, so you can return to it. It is cleared when you send the request. To discard a draft without sending, clear this site's data in your browser. Payment is made through a Razorpay link that Auric Artisan sends after confirming your campaign. Card and bank details are handled by Razorpay. While your campaign runs, the [Ad Library](../docs/ad-library.md) lists your creative, your brand as the advertiser, the format, the zones, the flight dates and the landing address, for the full run and at least 90 days after. Your campaign name, billing email and price are not listed.

text: - Every ad is labelled Sponsored . - Campaigns are placed by page context. The audience groups advertisers choose guide the creative review and do not identify or follow individual visitors. - Ads never track visitors across sites. - No third-party ad technology runs unless a visitor accepts the marketing cookie category. Cookie choices are covered in [Company and legal](../../company-and-legal/README.md). - The ad system counts impressions, viewable impressions and clicks to produce flight reports and to apply frequency caps. - Paid Auric Artisan subscribers browse without ads.

title: About Auric Artisan
text: Official page: https://auricartisan.com/company/about/ (last updated 27 July 2026). The official page is authoritative; this is a summary to help you find your way.

title: About Auric Artisan
heading: At a glance
text: - A platform for colour tools, colour-science resources, articles and structured learning material. - Web analysis across security, performance, responsive design, palette extraction and related checks. - Theme generation for colour systems, interfaces and web design. - CIE colour science: XYZ, Lab, LCH, Oklab, sRGB, Display P3, colour-difference formulas, chromatic adaptation, gamut mapping and metamerism. - More than 70 vision simulation models, based on Viénot 1999, Brettel 1997 and Machado 2009. - An Ishihara-style plate generator for learning and demonstration only — not a medical device. - Every tool free on every tier; optional paid plan passes are one-time purchases through Razorpay. - Independent, and not affiliated with any government or institution.

title: About Auric Artisan
heading: What the page covers, section by section
text: 1. About Auric Artisan — The platform is built and written by Chirag Bansal, who also writes every Learn article and the documentation. The name joins "Auric" (gold, warmth, luminance) and "Artisan" (careful craft). The page calls the current release "a working foundation — functional, researched, and expanding." 2. What Auric Artisan provides — Four capability areas: colour science and measurement, vision simulation, web analysis, and theme and design-system generation. 3. Colour science and spectral tools — The colour spaces covered (CIE 1931 XYZ, CIELAB, CIE LCH, CIELUV, Oklab and Oklch, sRGB, Display P3, Adobe RGB 1998, HSL/HSV/HSB, HWB and CMYK approximation); colour-difference metrics (CIE76, CIE94 and its graphic-arts variant, CIEDE2000, CMC l:c); chromatic adaptation (Von Kries, Bradford, CIECAT02, CAT16) and illuminants (D50, D55, D65, A, F2, F11 and LED series); gamut mapping, metamerism, contrast ratio, colour harmonies and Munsell reference. 4. Vision simulation models — Congenital deficiencies (the three dichromacies, three anomalous trichromacies, complete and incomplete achromatopsia), acquired conditions (cataracts, macular degeneration, glaucoma, diabetic retinopathy, optic neuritis) and low-vision models (blur, contrast loss, scotopic, mesopic and photophobia simulations). All are software models, not certified for clinical or safety-critical use. 5. Web analysis and accessibility checking — WCAG 2.1 and 2.2 contrast (AA 4.5:1 and 3:1; AAA 7:1 and 4.5:1), colour-blind-safe palette analysis, focus indicators, text alternatives, touch-target size; security headers; Core Web Vitals estimates and resource checks; palette extraction, dark-mode compatibility and responsive review. 6. Theme generation and design systems — Tonal scales in Oklab or Lab, semantic roles, automatic contrast pairing, dark-mode variants; exports to CSS custom properties, design-token JSON, Tailwind, SCSS, Figma-compatible styles, Swift/SwiftUI and Android/Jetpack Compose; palette import, comparison and a built-in accessibility audit. 7. Articles and learning resources — Topic areas from colour-space primers to design-token architecture, plus reference material. 8. Ishihara-style generator — For exploration and demonstration. The page's medical disclaimer: it is not a medical device, not a diagnostic test, and must not be used for clinical decisions, employment screening, certification or any official vision assessment. 9. Who uses Auric Artisan — Designers, developers, accessibility specialists, colour scientists, art directors, students and educators, print professionals, and game and film colourists. 10. Data and privacy principles — Collects only what is needed; does not sell personal information or build advertising profiles; preferences stay in the browser; colour inputs are processed locally where possible. 11. Pricing, sign-ups and availability — Accounts are live; paid access is sold as one-time passes; nothing auto-renews; features may change over time. 12. Independence and neutrality — Not a government entity or standards body; implementations follow published CIE standards, peer-reviewed research and W3C specifications. 13. Our philosophy — "Tools That Respect Intelligence": explain rather than obscure, and design with care for people with colour-vision deficiency, low vision or sensitivity to visual stimulation. Note: The About page says payments are "in INR". The pricing page and plan cards describe charging in US dollars outside India and rupees within it. For what you will actually be charged, follow the pricing page and the checkout. See [Plans and pricing](../../account-and-billing/docs/plans-and-pricing.md).
